sweptVolumeSpecification.type: Bounding Convex Hull of Tool Assembly between Pose0 and Pose1 (Minkowski Sum of tool cylinder and linear trajectory segment)
sweptVolumeSpecification.mathematicalGuarantee: Zero-tunneling guarantee: If SweptHull does not intersect obstacle BVH, entire continuous trajectory is certified collision-free.

conservativeAdvancement.condition: When SweptHull broad-phase indicates potential contact
conservativeAdvancement.algorithm: Iterative upper-bound time-of-impact calculation: dt_safe = distance(t) / max_velocity

discreteSamplingPolicy.allowedUse: Visualization timeline scrubbing only, accompanied by a 'SAMPLED_VISUALIZATION_ONLY' flag
